periods.label: 小丑的远隔操偶

status.current: injured by Toka's countercurrent during remote puppet test

relationships.toka-todo: Her Raikiri destroys his relay puppet and burns his left hand through the wires.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Converses with him after the puppet test and notes his coldness toward Stella.
relationships.akatsuki: Participant in the upcoming Eve Festival operation.

periods.summary: The unidentified puppeteer behind the Okutama giant is revealed in a dark room as a tall man who calls himself a clown. He had been testing a new relay puppet by remotely controlling stone constructs from over one hundred kilometers away. Toka's lightning travels back through his wires and burns his left hand so badly he casually severs it, treating the injury as part of the amusement. His conversation with another Akatsuki-aligned guest foreshadows the group's imminent operation.

key_events.summary: Controls the stone puppets that attack Ikki and Stella.
Revealed as the injured puppeteer and Akatsuki collaborator.
